Hello, I am Liang Zhang.

I am currently a Lecturer at the College of Education, China West Normal University. I received my Ph.D. in Cognitive Neuroscience from Beijing Normal University.

## Research Interests

- Cognitive abilities and individual differences
- Psychometrics and latent variable modeling
- Brain networks and cognitive neuroscience
- Reproducible data analysis with R

## About This Site

This blog is where I share notes on research, methods, and coding practices that I find useful in everyday work.
